Name: Portrait and Sprite Replacements for Grey - Therapist NPC
Author: crownhouses
Description:
I created new portraits and sprites for Grey, from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20597]Endwyr's Therapist NPC mod[/url]. Has a standard, beach, and winter variant (the same as the original mod). 

All credit for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20597?tab=description]'Therapist NPC - Grey'[/url] goes to Endwyr. 

I used and/or tweaked assets from [url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdvcharactercreator]Stardew Valley Character Creator by Poltergeister & Jaz [/url]and [url=https://sqbr.github.io/browser-dollmaker/]Stardew Valley Dollmaker by sqbr[color=#ffffff]. [/color][/url]Massive thank you to the creators of these tools.

[size=5]INSTALLATION GUIDE:
[/size]1. Download the original Therapist NPC﻿ mod and install it FIRST.
2. Download this file and unzip. 
3. Drag the folder titled "[Endwyr] TherapistNPC" into your mods folder and ALLOW it to overwrite the original mod files. 
(Make sure the original mod is already inside your mods folder, otherwise it will not work)

If you have any issues, or if at any point in time the original mod is updated and the folder name is changed, you can manually drop my "Portraits" and "Sprites" folders into the "Assets" folder of the original mod and allow it to overwrite.

I made this for personal use to align a bit more with vanilla style, and wanted to share. Thank you to Endwyr for creating an amazing custom character mod!

If you have SVE, don't forget to download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21765]SVE Patch[/url] for Grey's house.

This is my first mod upload so let me know if you encounter any issues.

Downloads.Description: A simple redesign of Grey's portraits and sprites.
